uncitedSentences.sentence: Evidence on learner response is largely naturalistic.

content.text: Evidence on learner response is largely naturalistic. A 16-week naturalistic case study of two Chinese students found that the highly engaged learner outperformed the moderately engaged learner in responding to both teacher and automated feedback and in improving her text (Zhang & Hyland, 2018). In an integrated approach combining automated, peer, and teacher feedback, most of 33 students actively engaged and the approach promoted behavioural, affective, and cognitive engagement and thoughtful revisions (Zhang & Hyland, 2021). A synthesis of 50 naturalistic classroom studies identified teacher practices, learner responses, stakeholder beliefs, and motivation and emotions as major themes (Mao et al., 2024).
